title: Auto Electrician II
description:
Summary
Responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and installing electrical systems in both light and heavy-duty vehicles, including A/C systems and electronic modules.
Duties and Responsibilities
Diagnose and repair electrical faults in commercial vehicles.
Install and maintain wiring systems, lighting, control modules, and related components.
Use diagnostic tools to troubleshoot electronic systems.
Work on engine management systems (Euro IV and Euro V engines).
Service, install, and fault-check vehicle air conditioning systems.
Maintain job records and report completed work to the supervisor.
Experience with excavators, backhoes, loaders, and dump trucks.
Exposure to hybrid vehicle systems.
Job Requirements
Minimum Diploma in Auto Electrical or related field.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience as an Auto Electrician.
Basic understanding of safety and electrical standards in automotive work.
